data.prompt: In Shen Xiaoman's small bedroom late at night, lit only by the warm, dim desk lamp. Two people, neither smiling: on screen left Shen Xiaoman in her light grey hoodie and black track pants sits on the bed, her right hand holding the phone out toward Yuetang, the back of the phone to the camera; on screen right Shen Yuetang in her moon-white high-collared shirt and navy long skirt sits on the edge of the bed and does not take it. The desk lamp glows behind. Xiaoman's hand stops in mid-air in front of Yuetang. Yuetang does not reach out; her hands stay folded on her knees and she looks straight into Xiaoman's eyes. Shen Yuetang speaks a Mandarin line, her lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, low and slow, every word steady. Xiaoman keeps her mouth closed and holds her breath.
